gExpandedPlaceholder_Chan.provenance: The Japanese cart's own row, verbatim: the honorific {KUN} expands to after the player's name (pokefirered/src/string_util.c:386, ExpandPlaceholder_KunChan, by the player's gender). The US cart's row is empty, so the join, which needs an English line, never ships it. gen1recomp does not expand {KUN} in FireRed yet (docs/upstream-fixes.md, FireRed entry 18).

The US cart's row is empty, so the join, which needs an English line, never ships it. gen1recomp does not expand {KUN} in FireRed yet (docs/upstream-fixes.md, FireRed entry 18).

sText_AttackerUsedX.provenance: The cart's row is "[B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX][B_BUFF1]\n[B_BUFF2]": the particle and the ending appended to the move's name depend on the move (ChooseMoveUsedParticle and ChooseTypeOfMoveUsedString, pokefirered/src/battle_message.c:2325, :2365). gen1recomp fills no particle and always appends sText_ExclamationMark (src/core/game3/battle/battle_text.lua:249), so the Japanese overrides give both the values of the moves outside sGrammarMoveUsedTable, most of them: the particle sText_ApostropheS ("の") here, and the ending sText_ExclamationMark5 ("！") under sText_ExclamationMark. The line reads "ポチエナの\nたいあたり！", as the cart prints it for those moves; the same overrides as Emerald's.

sText_ExclamationMark.provenance: The cart's sText_ExclamationMark5 row ("！"), the ending of the moves outside sGrammarMoveUsedTable (pokefirered/src/battle_message.c:2396). gen1recomp appends sText_ExclamationMark to every move's name (src/core/game3/battle/battle_text.lua:249), whose Japanese row is the ending of a small group of moves ("を　つかった！"); see sText_AttackerUsedX.
